# API surface coverage

Deterministic source inventory. Evidence status is confirmed, conditional, or refuted. Behavioral disposition separates asserted operation tests from metadata-only evidence. `test_operation_contract_metadata` checks inventory metadata only.
Reproduce with `python tools/surface_inventory.py --check --task-id T19`.

| Surface | Name | Evidence status | Owner | Acceptance | Reproduction | Evidence | Operation ID | State | Owner task | Handler | Contract | Contract gaps | Fixtures | Access classification | Cache key | Tenant scope | Provenance | Test IDs | Test coverage | Behavioral disposition | Benchmark cohort | Task ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
